meta.author: Shibbieness (Mark)
meta.notes: Colors mostly not stated in source; entries with inferred_colors=true use plausible palettes. Race height/build/ears largely inferred from stated doorway/ceiling scales and genre convention. 'Goblin improvised-into-comfort' is canonical vocabulary (never 'cluttered').

races.name: Human
races.summary: Reference baseline race; stone-and-timber, moderate on every axis.

races.name: Elf
races.summary: Long-lived, calligraphic, nature-integrated builders of grown wood and crystal.

races.name: Dwarf
races.summary: Long-lived clan-bound forge folk who carve cities into mountains (1.6m ceilings).

races.name: Orc
races.summary: Honor-coded martial race; functional, heavy, defensible architecture.

races.name: Goblin
races.summary: Small (~1.2m) tinkerers whose homes are improvised-into-comfort; core race on surface and in dungeons.

races.name: Halfling
races.summary: Small hearth-loving folk of round rooms, textiles and big pantries (1.5m ceilings).

races.name: Gnome
races.summary: Eccentric mechanical tinkerers with workshop space in nearly every room.

races.name: Tiefling
races.summary: Infernal-aesthetic scholarly folk; dark, precise geometric decor, comfortable in low light.

races.name: Dungeon Dweller
races.summary: Any origin race that stayed underground; identity tied to the dungeon, not the origin race.

races.name: Infernal
races.summary: Hierarchical contract-bound race of the infernal realm; metallic reds and blacks, scorched paper.

races.name: Divine
races.summary: Race of illuminated gold-and-halo civic order; everything slightly too perfect.

races.name: Half-Elf
races.summary: Mixed-race; blended elven and human aesthetics per upbringing.

races.name: Half-Orc
races.summary: Mixed-race; blended orcish and human aesthetics per upbringing.

races.name: Wood Elf
races.summary: Wilderness forest-integrated elves, less civic.

races.name: Mountain Dwarf
races.summary: Wilderness dwarf clans of the mountain heights.

races.name: Coastal Halfling
races.summary: Seafaring halfling clans; Feral-Coast lines can dive reefs unaided.

races.name: Wild Orc
races.summary: Tribal orcs of plains and hills.

races.name: Gnome-Tinker
races.summary: Gnomes who keep wilderness workshops.

races.name: Hill-Goblin
races.summary: Surface goblin variant preferring remote hill country.

races.name: Wanderer-Human
races.summary: Human nomad peoples with distinct culture.

races.name: Lake-Tending Human
races.summary: Human lineage of tended lakes; Swimming Grace, Cold Water Adaptation.

races.name: Coastal-Temple Elf
races.summary: Elves of water temples; strongest lines have inborn Water-Breathing.

races.name: Flooded-Dungeon Adapted Dwarf
races.summary: Dwarves of flooded holds; Pressure Resistance, heavy Salt Tolerance.

races.name: Tide-Reader Goblin
races.summary: Coastal goblin variant with inherited Tide-Reading.

races.name: Surface Goblin
races.summary: Goblins of surface hamlets to metropolises; many small windows, gardens.

races.name: Dungeon Goblin
races.summary: Warren goblins lit by tended glow-fungi (blue-cap); shaft-and-ladder homes.

races.name: Duergar
races.summary: Deep-dwarves: tougher, darker, more clan-bound cousins of surface dwarves.

races.name: Drow
races.summary: Matriarchal spider-worshipping elves of hierarchical spire-cities.

races.name: Cave-Orc
races.summary: Larger-than-surface orcs of warlord-warrens with ritual combat.

races.name: Crystal-clan
races.summary: Rare crystalline humanoids of geode-settlements.

races.name: Dungeon-Ratfolk
races.summary: Ratmen of layered market-burrows and secretive networks.

races.name: Kuo-toa
races.summary: Fish-folk of flooded deep areas and underwater wilds.

races.name: Merfolk
races.summary: Fully aquatic humanoids with fish-like lower body; desiccate out of water.

races.name: Sea-Elf
races.summary: Aquatic elven variant; refined, water-breathing, keepers of sunken libraries.

races.name: Drowned-Hall Dwarf
races.summary: Aquatic dwarves who engineer sealed air halls; pressure-immune, cold-adapted, do not breathe water.

races.name: River-Halfling
races.summary: Freshwater halflings living on houseboats.

races.name: Selkie-folk
races.summary: Rare shapechanging human/elf variant living between sea and land.

biomes.name: Forest
biomes.summary: Tree-dominated regions from temperate to jungle, haunted and fey.

biomes.name: Mountain
biomes.summary: Elevated rocky regions: hills to snow peaks, volcanic and crystal.

biomes.name: Coast
biomes.summary: Land-sea interface: beaches, cliffs, mangroves, frozen coasts.

biomes.name: Swamp
biomes.summary: Water-saturated lowlands: marsh, bog, blighted and mana-swamps.

biomes.name: Plain
biomes.summary: Open grassland, prairie, steppe and flowering meadows.

biomes.name: Desert
biomes.summary: Arid sand, rock, salt flats, glass desert and oases.

biomes.name: Tundra
biomes.summary: Cold permafrost, glacier edge and frozen taiga.

biomes.name: Badlands
biomes.summary: Eroded canyon lands, plateaus, volcanic ash and scarred battlefields.

biomes.name: Underwater
biomes.summary: Aquatic sub-space: reefs, kelp forests, open/deep ocean, trenches, lakes, sunken ruins, mana tide.

flora.name: Druid-oak
flora.notes: One protected tree at each Enchanted Grove centre.

flora.name: Lake-Lily
flora.notes: Floating white flowers of freshwater lakes.

flora.name: Glow-Alga
flora.notes: Primary light source in some cave lakes.

flora.name: Tomb-Rose
flora.notes: Dungeon plant: crimson flowers on ancient graves.

fungi.name: Blue-Cap
fungi.notes: Dungeon-goblin household glow-fungus; 'a well-grown blue-cap is the mark of a settled household'.

ores.name: Star-Iron
ores.notes: Stage 5/6 ores below have biome null = dungeon/event-sourced.

stations.name: Improvised Forge
stations.summary: Pit of rocks, hand-bellows, clay-lined firebricks; no parent station needed.

stations.name: Basic Forge
stations.summary: Proper stone hearth and iron-cast anvil; hamlet/village default.

stations.name: Standard Forge
stations.summary: Urban default with ventilation; can make MASTER-tier weapons.

stations.name: Masterwork Forge
stations.summary: Heirloom forge with Mithril plate and Heart-Ore anvil.

stations.name: Legendary Forge
stations.summary: Unique; Adamantite plate and Dragon-Iron core, ritual-forged.

stations.name: Improvised Carpenter's Bench
stations.summary: Planks laid across two stumps.

stations.name: Improvised Alchemy Station
stations.summary: Portable cauldron over a fire ring.

stations.name: Basic Alchemy Station
stations.summary: Glass distillery and proper reagent shelves.

stations.name: Basic Carpenter's Bench
stations.summary: Real work surface with clamps.

stations.name: Scribing Desk
stations.summary: Writing desks with ink, parchment, quill and drying racks. Same 5-tier recipe chain as the forge (shown at BASIC).

stations.name: Loom
stations.summary: Tailoring loom with cutting tables. Same 5-tier recipe chain as the forge (shown at BASIC).

stations.name: Tanning Rack
stations.summary: Leather-working rack. Same 5-tier recipe chain as the forge (shown at BASIC).

stations.name: Jewelry-working Station
stations.summary: Fine metal and gem work. Same 5-tier recipe chain as the forge (shown at BASIC).

stations.name: Binding Frame
stations.summary: Tome-binding ritual frame; mage academies hold STANDARD ones. Same 5-tier recipe chain as the forge (shown at BASIC).

stations.name: Enchanting Pedestal
stations.summary: Magical-item work. Same 5-tier recipe chain as the forge (shown at BASIC).

stations.name: Anvil
stations.summary: Smithy fixture paired with the forge. Same 5-tier recipe chain as the forge (shown at BASIC).

stations.name: Quenching Tank
stations.summary: Smithy fixture for quenching. Same 5-tier recipe chain as the forge (shown at BASIC).

stations.name: Distillation Apparatus
stations.summary: Alchemy lab still. Same 5-tier recipe chain as the forge (shown at BASIC).

stations.name: Lathe
stations.summary: Carpentry workshop fixture. Same 5-tier recipe chain as the forge (shown at BASIC).

stations.name: Brewing Vats
stations.summary: Alchemy lab vats. Same 5-tier recipe chain as the forge (shown at BASIC).

districts_or_buildings.name: Market District
districts_or_buildings.summary: Shops and stalls; goblin markets blur shop and stall.

districts_or_buildings.name: Artisan District
districts_or_buildings.summary: Workshop-shops with master and apprentice housing.

districts_or_buildings.name: Inn
districts_or_buildings.summary: Mandatory in every city; rest/heal venue.

districts_or_buildings.name: Herbalist-Alchemist
districts_or_buildings.summary: Guaranteed at HAMLET scale; processes tended-adjacency yield.
